subject: CloudMed evaluation: POC activation checklist & timeline
messages:
From: Aisha Lawrence <aisha.lawrence@cloudmed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CloudMed POC — kickoff and info we need

Hi Neha / Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo today. We’re excited to move forward with a short evaluation focused on: throughput for our batch triage use case and latency for interactive clinician assistants. To unblock procurement and infra, can you share a concise MAP that lists the exact POC environment requirements and a realistic close timeline?

Specifically CloudMed needs clarity on: org provisioning (who creates the tenant), API key lifecycle (ephemeral vs long-lived), required IP ranges for allowlist, and whether VPC peering is mandatory for data flows. Tom from procurement is looped for contract rhythm.

Ideal target: 2–3 week evaluation window starting in Jan if we can get keys and allowlist done before EoY.

Thanks — Aisha

Aisha Lawrence
Director, Integrations — CloudMed
A: 415-555-0198
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Lawrence <aisha.lawrence@cloudmed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudMed POC — kickoff and info we need

Hi Aisha —

Great to hear — I put together a compact MAP and a POC activation checklist attached (MAP-draft-CloudMed.pdf). High level:

- Owner & org setup: CloudMed will provision an org seat in our Console. Either Aisha or your infra admin can create the tenant; we can also ship a seed invite if you prefer Redwood to create it and hand off admin rights.
- API keys: we recommend issuing a short-lived (24h) ephemeral key for early smoke tests and a single service key (rotated monthly) for load testing. We’ll provide a small CLI helper to rotate keys.
- IP allowlist: please provide the CIDRs that will reach our hosted endpoints. Minimum requirement: one static outbound range per data cluster. I attached a sample CSV (network-cidrs.csv) with placeholders.
- VPC peering: optional for this evaluation. If you want private connectivity we can initiate a peering request; most customers evaluate on hosted endpoints first and add peering for production. If peering is desired, list the VPC ID and preferred region.

Proposed short timeline:
1) Week 0 (this week): confirm owner, return CIDRs and procurement contact (Tom).
2) Week 1: org created, keys issued, first smoke tests.
3) Week 2: full-load evaluation, collect perf traces and cost metrics.
4) Week 3: close/next steps (decision & contract).

Can you confirm that timeline and whether you want us to create the org tenant? I also put a Drive folder link in the MAP for sample configs.

Attachments: MAP-draft-CloudMed.pdf, network-cidrs.csv

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0142
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aisha Lawrence <aisha.lawrence@cloudmed.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudMed POC — kickoff and info we need

A quick technical addendum —

- API keys: for the load test please use the service key (rate-limited) and run with KV cache warmed; ephemeral keys are fine for interactive testing.
- IP allowlist: we’ll need any NATed egress CIDRs if traffic comes through a private gateway. For hosted runs the important ones are 35.XXX.XXX.0/24 and 34.XXX.XXX.0/24 (we’ll confirm final ranges in the MAP PDF).
- VPC peering: if you opt in, expect a short routing window and a certificate exchange. We can pre-stage the peering request once you give VPC ID + ASN.

Propose 30-min tech kickoff on Monday to align on test harness and SLAs. Who should I invite from your infra team?

Jordan Blake
Principle Infra PM, Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Lawrence <aisha.lawrence@cloudmed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@cloudmed.com>, procurement@cloudmed.com
Date: 2026-12-20T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudMed POC — kickoff and info we need

Thanks Neha, Jordan —

That looks good. We’ll take Redwood creating the tenant and we’ll hand admin to me afterwards (saves time). I attached procurement info to this thread (see DocuSign link below). Tom will be our contact for contract terms — he’s OK to run the 3-week window in Jan if keys and allowlist are complete before Jan 6.

Procurement contact: Tom Hale (tom.hale@cloudmed.com).
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/CLD-5821 (I sent a starter SOW).

Next: please create the tenant and send the initial ephemeral key + the sample CSV filled with your suggested CIDRs for us to apply. We’ll schedule the 30-min technical kickoff for Monday 12/27 if that works.

Best —
Aisha

Thanks Aisha —

Confirmed. Action items from Redwood:
- I will create the CloudMed org tenant today and invite Aisha as admin.
- Jordan will open the temporary service key and the 24h ephemeral key for your smoke tests; keys will be posted to the Drive folder and also delivered via our secure key exchange link.
- Rachel will update the MAP PDF with the final ranges and a short runbook for running the load harness.

I’ll follow up with the Drive link (MAP + key instructions) and the Monday invite for the 30-min tech sync. HubSpot deal is updated: CLD-5821.
